reference.title: HTTP Examples
reference.shortdesc: This section describes the HTTP-related operational procedures, including instance creation, general parameter configuration, and GET/PUT/POST request handling etc.

section.title: Instance Creation & Parameter Configuration
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPCREATE="http://120.27.12.119:10080" /*Instance creation*/ +MHTTPCREATE: 0 OK AT+MHTTPCFG="header",0,"Connection: close" /*Header configuration (Configure according to actual requirements)*/ OK AT+MHTTPCFG="header",0 +MHTTPCFG: "header",0,19,Connection: close OK AT+MHTTPHEADER=0,0,0,"api-key: FC9B69m4prHH2j7ljBbA=hHlbMI=" OK
section.note: Post-initialization and pre-request, parameters are configurable. The example above demonstrates minimal setup. Users may perform additional parameter configuration at this stage according to actual application requirements.

section.title: GET Request
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,1,0,"/get" /*GET request*/ OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,225,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:18:46 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 145 Connection: close Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,145,145,145,{"args":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"0","Host":"localhost:6000"},"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/get"}

section.title: POST Request
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,0,"{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"}" /*content configuration. ML302S/ML307S/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML305U/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307M/ML307H/ML307N/ML307X/ML307Y: String parameters must not contain the quotation mark. To include quotation mark within string parameters, data mode transmission shall be used. */ OK AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,2,0,"/post" /*POST request*/ OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,220,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:25:23 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 278 Connection: close Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,278,278,278,{"args":{},"data":"{\"id\":\"speed1\"\\r,\"tags\":[\"mobile\"],\"unit\":\"m/s\"\\r,\"unit_symbol\":\"m/s\"}","files":{},"form":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"70","Host":"localhost:6000"},"json":null,"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/post"}

section.title: PUT request
section.msgblock:
AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,0,"{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"}" /*content configuration. To include quotation mark within string parameters, data mode transmission shall be used. */ OK AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,3,0,"/put" /*PUT Request */ OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,220,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:26:42 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 277 Connection: close Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true

section.title: POST Request in the Chunked Mode
section.msgblock:
AT+MHTTPCREATE="http://api.heclouds.com/" /*Instance creation*/ +MHTTPCREATE: 0 OK AT+MHTTPCFG="chunked",0,1 /*Configure to chunked mode*/ OK AT+MHTTPCFG="encoding",0,2 /*Escape character input configuration*/ OK AT+MHTTPCFG="header",0,"api-key: 2ATvkByTxig2uy55rlQPLf3xxVY=" /*Header configuration*/ OK AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,2,0,"/devices/622957377/datastreams" /*POST request send*/ OK +MHTTPURC: "ind",0 /*URC report, indicating content data can be sent. */ AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,0,"{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"}"/*Data send*/ OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,175,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2021 07:33:31 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 66 Connection: keep-alive Server: Apache-Coyote/1.1 Pragma: no-cache
+MHTTPURC: "content",0,66,66,66,{"errno":11,"error":"datastream already exists: 622957377.speed1"}
